summary: TeamAI is a v0.1.0 Next.js web app that orchestrates multi-agent Claude Code CLI workflows. Current state: core pipeline engine (ProcessManager + Orchestrator) functional, Kanban board with real-time WebSocket streaming, interactive terminals via xterm.js, multi-provider support, and basic crash recovery. The product has a solid foundation but is pre-production — missing authentication, CI/CD, database persistence, and several UI polish items.

security.title: No authentication or authorization
security.description: The app has no login, session management, or access control. Anyone with network access to the server can control all projects, spawn agent sessions, and view sensitive data.
security.fix: Add NextAuth.js or similar authentication with role-based access control.

security.title: WebSocket connections are unauthenticated
security.description: The /ws WebSocket endpoint accepts connections from any client without token validation.
security.fix: Require auth token on WebSocket upgrade handshake.

security.title: ExecFileSync used with user-facing inputs
security.description: Several server actions call execFileSync with arguments derived from user input (e.g., project paths). While git commands are unlikely to be exploitable, a path traversal via project name could cause unexpected behavior.
security.fix: Sanitize and validate all paths before passing to execFileSync.

performance.title: No caching layer for task/project data
performance.description: Every page load reads from disk (JSON files). No in-memory cache or React cache() usage.
performance.fix: Add React cache() wrappers or an in-memory TTL cache for frequently-read data.

performance.title: WebSocket broadcasts are global
performance.description: Phase-change and agent events are broadcast to ALL connected clients regardless of which project they're viewing. This creates unnecessary traffic for multi-project setups.
performance.fix: Scope WebSocket broadcasts to project-level rooms.

performance.title: No bundle analysis or code splitting
performance.description: No Next.js dynamic imports or bundle size monitoring in place.
performance.fix: Add dynamic imports for heavy pages and set up bundle analyzer.

code_quality.title: Widespread empty catch blocks mask errors
code_quality.description: Over 60 try/catch blocks use empty catch bodies or just fall-through comments. Silent error swallowing makes debugging nearly impossible and can hide critical failures.
code_quality.fix: Add structured error logging to all catch blocks. Use a centralized logger that can be toggled for debug mode.

code_quality.title: eslint-disable-next-line for 'any' type scattered throughout
code_quality.description: Multiple files disable the no-explicit-any rule, particularly in tests and type assertions. Some production code also uses 'any' casts.
code_quality.fix: Replace 'any' casts with proper type definitions. Use unknown + type guards instead.

code_quality.title: No integration tests for the pipeline orchestrator
code_quality.description: Unit tests exist for ProcessManager and Orchestrator, but no integration test verifies the full pipeline flow (spec → plan → implement → QA → merge).
code_quality.fix: Add an integration test that mocks the Claude CLI and verifies the full phase progression.

code_quality.title: Duplicate JSON file read patterns across actions
code_quality.description: Nearly identical try/catch + JSON.parse patterns for reading .teamai config files appear in 8+ action files.
code_quality.fix: Extract a shared readJSONConfig helper to reduce duplication.

infrastructure.title: No database — all state is JSON files on disk
infrastructure.description: Task state, project config, and pipeline progress are all stored as JSON files. This works for single-user local use but won't scale to multi-user or production deployments.
infrastructure.fix: Add an optional SQLite (better-sqlite3) or PostgreSQL backend behind the existing store interfaces.

infrastructure.title: No CI/CD pipeline
infrastructure.description: No GitHub Actions, no automated test runs on push, no deployment automation.
infrastructure.fix: Add GitHub Actions workflow for lint, typecheck, test on PR and push to main.

infrastructure.title: No health check endpoint
infrastructure.description: No /health or /api/health endpoint for monitoring. Container orchestration requires this.
infrastructure.fix: Add a GET /api/health endpoint that returns process and connection status.

infrastructure.title: No structured logging
infrastructure.description: All logging uses console.log/error. No log levels, no structured fields, no log rotation.
infrastructure.fix: Integrate pino or winston for structured JSON logging with configurable levels.

infrastructure.title: No Docker production image
infrastructure.description: No Dockerfile for production deployment. Devcontainer exists but only for development.
infrastructure.fix: Add a multi-stage Dockerfile for production deployment.

competitors.name: Aider
competitors.whereTheyAreAhead: Mature edit formats (architect/editor mode), map-reduce for large repos, extensive language support, active open-source community
competitors.whereWeAreAhead: Full Kanban UI, multi-agent pipeline with defined roles, PTY terminals, project management features
competitors.recentDirection: Focusing on edit format reliability and benchmark performance

competitors.name: Cline (VS Code)
competitors.overlap: Claude-powered autonomous coding, multi-step task execution
competitors.whereTheyAreAhead: Tight VS Code integration, MCP server support, file creation/deletion tools, checkpoints for rollback
competitors.whereWeAreAhead: Headless pipeline mode, multi-agent concurrency, project-level orchestration, Kanban management
competitors.targetAudience: VS Code users wanting an autonomous agent in-editor
competitors.recentDirection: Adding MCP protocol support, browser automation, and checkpoint system

competitors.name: Cursor
competitors.whereTheyAreAhead: Full IDE with inline completions, Composer for multi-file edits, massive user base, polished UX
competitors.whereWeAreAhead: Pipeline orchestration, defined agent roles, headless batch processing, project management features
competitors.targetAudience: Developers wanting an AI-first IDE replacement
competitors.recentDirection: Agent mode, rules system, MCP support, improving Composer

competitors.name: OpenHands (formerly OpenDevin)
competitors.overlap: Autonomous agent coding, multi-step task execution, Docker sandboxing
competitors.whereTheyAreAhead: Full sandboxed environment, web UI for agent interaction, broader agent capabilities (browser, shell, editor)
competitors.whereWeAreAhead: Pipeline phase structure, role specialization, lightweight (CLI-based, no Docker required), Kanban UI
competitors.targetAudience: Developers wanting an autonomous agent to tackle GitHub issues end-to-end
competitors.recentDirection: Improving agent reliability, adding evaluation framework, expanding tool support

competitors.name: Windsurf (Codeium)
competitors.whereTheyAreAhead: Cascade agent for multi-step reasoning, full IDE integration, large enterprise customer base
competitors.whereWeAreAhead: Multi-agent pipeline, project management, defined role system, headless CLI mode
competitors.recentDirection: Cascade agent improvements, enterprise features, multi-model support

now.title: Add authentication and access control
now.description: Add NextAuth.js with GitHub/Google OAuth. Protect WebSocket connections with token validation. Add role-based access (admin, viewer). Without this, the app cannot be deployed to any shared environment.
now.competitiveContext: All IDE-based competitors (Cursor, Windsurf) have auth. Critical for production use.

now.title: Replace console.log with structured logging
now.description: Integrate pino for structured JSON logging. Add log levels (debug, info, warn, error). Route all existing console.log calls through the logger. Add request ID tracking for debugging multi-agent sessions.

now.title: Set up CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions
now.description: Create GitHub Actions workflow that runs lint → typecheck → unit tests → E2E tests on every PR and push to main. Block merges on failures. Add automated Docker image build.

now.title: Fix empty catch blocks - add error reporting
now.description: Audit all ~60 empty catch blocks. Add structured error logging to each one. Create an ErrorBoundary component for React error handling. Add a global unhandled rejection handler in server.ts.

next.title: Scope WebSocket broadcasts to project rooms
next.description: Instead of broadcasting all events to all connected clients, create project-level rooms. Clients subscribe to the room for their active project. Reduces network traffic and prevents cross-project event leakage.

next.title: Add optional database backend (SQLite)
next.description: Implement a SQLite backend behind the TaskStore and ProjectStore interfaces. Keep JSON file storage as fallback. Enables concurrent access, better querying, and data integrity.
next.competitiveContext: OpenHands uses PostgreSQL. Aider uses git for state. Database enables multi-user scenarios.

next.title: Add MCP (Model Context Protocol) server support
next.description: Allow users to connect MCP servers to extend agent capabilities. Support MCP tools (browser automation, database queries, API calls) within pipeline phases. Cline and Cursor both recently added MCP support.
next.competitiveContext: Cline and Cursor have MCP support. Adding it keeps TeamAI competitive for power users.

next.title: Add pipeline integration tests
next.description: Create integration tests that mock the Claude CLI and verify full pipeline flow: spec → plan → implement → QA review → merge. Test recovery scenarios (crash mid-pipeline, rate limiting).

next.title: Add health check and monitoring endpoints
next.description: Add GET /api/health returning process uptime, active sessions count, WebSocket connection count, and container status. Add GET /api/metrics for Prometheus-style metrics.

next.title: Replace 'any' casts with proper types
next.description: Replace all eslint-disabled 'any' type casts in production code with proper interfaces. Use 'unknown' + type guards instead of direct 'any' casts.

later.title: Add in-memory caching for task/project data
later.description: Add React cache() wrappers and an in-memory TTL cache for frequently-read JSON data. Reduce disk I/O on every Kanban board render. Invalidate cache on task/project mutations via WebSocket events.

later.title: Extract shared config read helpers
later.description: Extract the repeated try/catch + JSON.parse pattern for reading .teamai config files into a shared utility function (readJSONConfig). Reduces duplication across 8+ action files.

later.title: Create production Docker image
later.description: Add a multi-stage Dockerfile for production deployment. Include Node.js runtime, Claude CLI, git, and optional Docker-in-Docker for container isolation. Publish to GitHub Container Registry.

later.title: Add bundle analysis and code splitting
later.description: Add @next/bundle-analyzer. Dynamic import heavy pages (terminals, roadmap). Lazy load xterm.js and Monaco editor. Reduce initial JS bundle size.

later.title: VS Code extension for TeamAI integration
later.description: Build a lightweight VS Code extension that surfaces TeamAI task status in the IDE. Show active pipeline phases, allow approving/rejecting QA reviews from the editor. Bridge the gap between headless orchestration and IDE-based workflows.
later.competitiveContext: Cline and Cursor dominate the IDE space. A VS Code extension would bridge TeamAI's headless orchestration with the IDE workflow.

later.title: Automated roadmap generation command improvements
later.description: Improve the /roadmap command to use the ideation scanner results from the UI. Auto-detect competitor list from the project domain. Add a 'Convert to Task' bulk action for roadmap items.

later.title: Multi-user collaboration support
later.description: Add multi-user support with project sharing, user presence indicators, and activity feed. Show which user is viewing/editing which task. Requires auth (P0) and database (P1) as prerequisites.
later.competitiveContext: None of the CLI-based competitors support multi-user. This would be a strong differentiator.

icebox.title: Slack/Teams notification integration
icebox.description: Send notifications to Slack or Teams when pipeline phases complete, QA reviews are ready, or tasks fail. Allow approving/rejecting reviews via Slack message buttons.

icebox.title: Full GitLab and Bitbucket merge support
icebox.description: Currently only GitHub PR creation is implemented. Add GitLab MR and Bitbucket PR support in the merger agent.

icebox.title: Agent performance analytics dashboard
icebox.description: Track agent success rates, cost per phase, time per phase, and QA pass/fail rates over time. Show trends and identify pipeline bottlenecks.
